draft_text: Tessaline appears to slightly outperform Varrow-NMT in BLEU on the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
revised_text: Tessaline significantly outperforms Varrow-NMT in BLEU on the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds; paired t-test, t=3.13, df=7, p=0.017, 95% CI [0.2, 1.44]).
rationale: T1.r1.bleu=28.4, T1.r2.bleu=27.6 match the sentence. S2 reports a significant paired t-test (p=0.017, CI [0.2,1.44]) for exactly this comparison, so the evidence supports a stronger claim than the hedged "appears to slightly outperform."
